Coram : S. SAGHIR AHMAD*, R.P. SETHI
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908-0rder 9, Rule 13-Exparte decree­ Power to set aside-Party to show sufficient cause for non-appearance on the date of hearing. Exparte decree-Setting aside of-Narrow and technical approach of court-Held, leads to unnecessary prolonging of litigation-Further, of Statutes-Liberal construction-To enable the court to do complete justice. A suit for arrears of rent, ejectment and damages filed against the appellant was decreed ex-parte due to non-appearance. The appellant filed an application under Order 9 Rule 13 of the Code of Civil
Decision Date : 03-03-2000 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 1934/2000 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
